title: Philosophy, B.S. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Confirmed byte-identical to the 2026-27 bulletin's Program Requirements, Course List, Degree Requirements, and General Education sections for this program: same 120cr total (45cr Gen Ed / 36cr Electives / 39cr Major), same PHIL 12 prescribed course, same four major-specific pools (Philosophical Foundations of Science: PHIL 11/13/110/125/125W/126/126W/127/129; Ethics and Science: PHIL 107/118/132/133N/134; Advanced Topics: PHIL 403/407/410/425W/426W/427/432; Formal Reasoning: CMPSC 111/121/131/360/441/442, ECON 306/402/411/414/474, IST 230/240, MATH 315/427/457/465/475Y/486, RM 301, SC 205N, SRA 231, STAT 318), and same unrestricted 3cr PHIL elective plus 6cr Advanced-Topics-or-Formal-Reasoning supporting-course requirement. No requirement difference found for this year vs. 2026, so this file reuses PHILBS-2026.json's full verified semester sequence unchanged (same MATH 3/4/21/22 remedial chain unlocking MATH 110's real MATH 22/41 prereq and, through it, CMPSC 121's concurrent requirement; same MATH 457 / CMPSC 121 Formal Reasoning pair, pinned one-per-semester per the one-completed-course-per-item rule; same 18.5cr/semester cap) -- these are the prereq/plan-structure fixes already verified against PHILBS-2026.json's build, and prerequisites for these specific courses (MATH 110, MATH 22/41, MATH 21, CMPSC 121, MATH 457) are drawn from the same current, campus- and catalog-agnostic university-wide course description pages CMPSC-2022.json's notes document (bulletins.psu.edu/university-course-descriptions/), so no separate prereq re-verification was needed per year. 2023-24 archive text matches 2022-23 exactly except MATH 315's row renders with no title text (a page-template quirk on bulletins.psu.edu's own archive, not a content change -- the course code and its 3cr weight are unchanged and still unused by this plan).
